en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a cobblestoned square in front of old stone houses and shops. A very large plane tree dominates the center, with several adults and children gathered beneath it. To the right is a low stone building with a tiled roof; to the left are small street stalls or shopfronts. The scene has a village or old-town atmosphere. Printed caption text in French appears along the bottom, and a website watermark is overlaid.
